summary_en: Ordinary dividend per share FY5/26 revised from 18 yen to 20 yen (+2 yen). Combined with 12 yen listing memorial dividend, full-year dividend reaches 32 yen per share. Payout ratio target 15%. Revision based on full-year earnings performance.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of dividend forecast for fiscal year ending May 2026 (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Geekly resolved on 14 July 2026 to increase its FY5/26 ordinary dividend forecast from 18 yen per share to 20 yen per share, an increase of 2 yen. Combined with the 12 yen listing memorial dividend, the total annual dividend will be 32 yen per share, compared to the prior forecast of 30 yen per share. The increase reflects full-year earnings performance. The company targets a payout ratio of approximately 15% as part of its progressive dividend policy, and intends to balance medium-to-long-term growth investment with shareholder returns focused on capital efficiency while maintaining financial soundness.
